reports.statistical_interpretation: Both stage and grade show very low ARI (0.021 and 0.011), indicating minimal overlap between the partition and these clinical labels. Homogeneity and completeness are also low (0.06-0.11), suggesting that the partition does not group patients by stage or grade. These metrics are not statistical independence tests but descriptive measures of label overlap.
reports.medical_interpretation: The partition is not a simple echo of stage or grade. This does not prove molecular novelty, as other clinical or biological factors may drive the partition. No clinical claims are made.
